verdict.rationale: incident.io's own docs cover all three parts of the story. Suggestions uses AI to automatically draft updates and summaries from incident activity, suggested summaries exist so responders don't have to digest and relay information themselves, and Scribe transcribes incident calls. The changelog adds org-configurable writing style and AI-drafted status page updates. missing for 10: Scribe is documented only through error/troubleshooting snippets, with no detail on structured call notes beyond transcription; no independent or hands-on corroboration of live AI writing quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI writes the incident as it happens — live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes — so responders respond instead of typing

citations.quote: Suggestions uses AI to help teams communicate better during incidents by automatically drafting updates, summaries and follow-up actions based on your incident activity.
responders don’t always have time to digest lots of information or communicate externally what’s going on... This is where suggested summaries comes in.
